author: TurkishDelite
body:
oh boy more feedback that's probably already been said in other threads already :P

In my opinion the reason why no other game modes besides nebula are played because of two things; The player base, how fun/interesting the gamemodes are and how polished they are.
Everyone wanted gamemodes like survival games back but when they brand it back it's not what we wanted for example; the typical maps, the no grace period, the resources in the chest and ect. The problem with bringing survival games back is that what the gamemode has to offer like I could go to mcsg if I wanted to play survival games because they polished the gamemode better then avicus they have better maps then avicus, also hypixel blitz survival games has quite a few people playing the gamemode because it's unique it's got something that other server don't have.
Avicus survival games doesn't have anything new or interesting to offer compared to other servers nebula is popular    because of the maps, how well it's done and how unique it is (besides ocn that I can think of)

Suggestion: add something like ranks,kits, control points, new maps, how well it's polished and ect give us something that makes us want to play the gamemodes here instead of other servers like ocn or hypixel or mcsg ect

Soz for bad grammar on phone :P
